state_transfer: same model and optimizer objects across stages
preprocessing_flops: excluded; elapsed time and energy included
train_transform:
Compose(
    RandomResizedCropAndInterpolation(size=(64, 64), scale=(0.08, 1.0), ratio=(0.75, 1.3333), interpolation=bicubic)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandAugment(n=2, ops=
	AugmentOp(name=AutoContrast, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=Equalize, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=Invert, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=Rotate, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=PosterizeIncreasing, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=SolarizeIncreasing, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=SolarizeAdd, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=ColorIncreasing, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=ContrastIncreasing, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=BrightnessIncreasing, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=SharpnessIncreasing, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=ShearX, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=ShearY, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=TranslateXRel, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5)
	AugmentOp(name=TranslateYRel, p=0.5, m=0, mstd=0.5))
    Resize(size=32, interpolation=lanczos, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=tensor([0.4850, 0.4560, 0.4060]), std=tensor([0.2290, 0.2240, 0.2250]))
    RandomErasing(p=0.25, mode=pixel, count=(1, 1))
)
eval_transform:
Compose(
    Resize(size=73, interpolation=bicubic, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    CenterCrop(size=(64, 64))
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=(0.485, 0.456, 0.406), std=(0.229, 0.224, 0.225))
)
